about: SHA-256 shows a file is unchanged since this manifest was written. It does not show the file was fetched correctly; the provenance fields say where each file came from.

files.source: Ethereum mainnet: calls and block headers from an archive node (endpoint not recorded), logs through the Etherscan API v2 (only on-chain fields kept); GitHub API and codeload.github.com for the issue and the Atlas, forum.skyeco.com for the forum note, Sourcify for Sky.sol
files.notes: Every call and log query is pinned to a block, so live_verify.py --check repeats the read against any Ethereum archive endpoint and compares. Post-report rows use the head pinned at write time (pinned_head).
